charge_port.notes: Toyota Canada release footnote: "MY2023-25 BEV drivers will need an CCS1 to J3400 adapter" to use NACS plugs, so the car's own port is CCS1. The US page says the same (CCS to J3400 adapter).
Toyota USA release footnote: "MY2023-25 BEV drivers will need a CCS to J3400 adapter (aka NACS Adapter)"; the 2026 bZ is the first with a standard NACS inlet.

supercharger_access.notes: Toyota USA: 2023-25 bZ4X owners need a CCS to J3400 adapter and get one free through a dealer from November 2025 (current state).
Toyota Canada: the NACS adaptor is designed exclusively for 2025 and earlier Toyota BEV models; with it owners can use the NACS network. Drive Tesla Canada reports the free adapter for 2023-25 bZ4X.
